column6: 由于身上永生的诅咒，他为阿莱斯蒂亚效力了永恒之久。\n久而久之，他被称为阿莱斯蒂亚的不朽之王。一个有趣的头衔。\n不过，民众对此并无怨言。他被视为一位伟大的统治者。

column5: He started to enjoy life, and he was no longer seeking to have the curse lifted.\nHe still had thoughts of wanting to die — perhaps to see his love in the afterlife.\nBut these were fleeting, and the memories of your time together were more than enough.
column6: 他开始享受生活，不再寻求解除诅咒。\n他偶尔仍会冒出想死的念头——或许是想到来世与爱人重逢。\n但这些念头转瞬即逝，你们共度时光的回忆已足以慰藉。

column5: With your sacrifice, there was nobody left to lead Alestia.\nUlric, stepping up, took on the role of first King of The Monarchy.\nHis goal was clear — to educate the world on the new status quo.
column6: 由于你的牺牲，再没有人来领导阿莱斯蒂亚。\n乌尔里克挺身而出，担起了王室首位国王的角色。\n他的目标很明确——让世界了解新的秩序。

column5: People slowly learned and adjusted to news of The Triumvirate's fall.\nBut with many years of hard work, they had come to enjoy Ulric's rule.\nAlestians lived in peace, never fearing what their rulers may do to them.
column6: 人们慢慢了解并适应了三人执政团覆灭的消息。\n经过多年的努力，他们终于乐于接受乌尔里克的统治。\n阿莱斯蒂亚人安居乐业，从不担心统治者会对自己做什么。

column5: He had a statue of you erected in the Town Square of Balteus.\nYou would forever be remembered as The First Monarch. A hero.\nEvery ruler in the future would owe their power to you and your sacrifice.
column6: 他在巴尔泰乌斯的城镇广场为你立起了一座雕像。\n你会永远被铭记为第一位君主。一位英雄。\n未来每一位统治者的权柄，都要归功于你和你的牺牲。

column5: With his curse lifted, he was no longer afraid of dying.\nHe served Alestia until he was lost to old age, passing away happilly.\nThough new rulers came and went, he was always remembered as the best.
column6: 诅咒解除后，他不再畏惧死亡。\n他为阿莱斯蒂亚效力，直到因年迈而离世，安然辞世。\n尽管新统治者来来去去，他始终被铭记为最好的那一位。

column5: He served Alestia for an eternity because of the curse of immortality upon him.\nOver time, he became known as The Immortal King of Alestia. An interesting title.\nThe people didn't complain about this, however. He was seen as a great ruler.
column6: 由于身上永生的诅咒，他为阿莱斯蒂亚效力了永恒之久。\n久而久之，他被称为阿莱斯蒂亚的不朽之王。一个有趣的头衔。\n不过，民众对此并无怨言。他被视为一位伟大的统治者。

column5: He started to enjoy life, and no longer sought to have his curse removed.
column6: 他开始享受生活，不再寻求解除自己的诅咒。

column5: Thanks to your efforts, Ulric was able to live a happy life, free from The Triumvirate.\nThe shadows of his past soon dissipated, and he turned into a new man — truly loved by the people.\nThough his secrets never came to light, he had certainly done enough work to make up for them.
column6: 多亏你的努力，乌尔里克得以过上幸福的生活，摆脱了三人执政团。\n他过往的阴影很快消散，他蜕变成了一个全新的人——深受人民爱戴。\n尽管他的秘密从未曝光，他所做的一切已足以弥补。

column5: After the battle for Alestia, Damek had a lot of work to do.\nGoing from a member of The Rebellion, to a leader in The Monarchy was a huge change.\nHe was no longer part of a small army — his actions affected the entire world.
column6: 阿莱斯蒂亚之战后，达梅克有许多工作要做。\n从反抗军的一员，变成王室的领导者，是巨大的转变。\n他不再是一支小军队中的一员——他的行动影响着整个世界。

column5: He remained a loyal servant to the throne of Alestia, carrying out your every order.\nBeing originally in charge of The Rebellion, it made no sense to back down after victory.\nYour love grew ever stronger — held together by an unbreakable bond formed in strife.
column6: 他始终效忠阿莱斯蒂亚王座，执行你的每一条命令。\n他本就是反抗军的负责人，胜利之后没有退缩的道理。\n你们的爱愈发深厚——由患难中结成的牢不可破的羁绊维系着。

column5: He remained a loyal servant to the throne of Alestia, carrying out your every order.\nBeing originally in charge of The Rebellion, it made no sense to back down after victory.\nYour friendship grew ever stronger — held together by an unbreakable bond formed in strife.
column6: 他始终效忠阿莱斯蒂亚王座，执行你的每一条命令。\n他本就是反抗军的负责人，胜利之后没有退缩的道理。\n你们的友谊愈发深厚——由患难中结成的牢不可破的羁绊维系着。

column5: As your closest advisor, you spent almost every waking moment together.\nThe war did not win you rest, for in your victory, the work had only just begun.\nUniting a confused world, and winning over their love as ruler was a daunting task.
column6: 作为你最亲近的顾问，你们几乎醒着的每一刻都在一起。\n战争并未给你们带来安宁，因为胜利之后，工作才刚刚开始。\n团结一个迷茫的世界，并作为统治者赢得民众的爱戴，是一项艰巨的任务。

column5: But it was a task that you two completed, side by side.\nDamek was just as important to history as you, and he was never forgotten.\nThe tale of his growth from orphan child to world leader inspired generations to come.
column6: 但你们两人并肩完成了这项任务。\n达梅克对历史的重要性不亚于你，他从未被遗忘。\n他从孤儿成长为世界领袖的故事，激励了后世之人。

column5: As you didn't appoint him as your advisor, you made him a General instead.\nIt was his job to gather and train an army, like Salus had done before him.\nWith his leadership and strategy, any future insurrections would surely fall.
column6: 由于你没有任命他为顾问，你转而让他当上了将军。\n他的职责是招募并训练军队，就像他之前的萨卢斯那样。\n凭他的领导与谋略，未来任何叛乱都必将被平定。

column5: Under his command, your might soon became unparalleled.\nBut as your rule was accepted almost universally, war and battle were rare.\nPeople would compare his new role to that of The Triumvirate's old Inquisition.
column6: 在他的统领下，你的武力很快变得无可匹敌。\n但由于你的统治几乎被普遍接受，战争与战斗十分罕见。\n人们会把他这一新角色与三人执政团昔日的审判庭相提并论。

column5: However, in this case — the amount of honor to guard was plentiful.
column6: 不过，这一回——值得守护的荣誉可谓数不胜数。

column5: Damek eventually got over all of the fears that controlled him.\nHe paid visits to the spot where he lost his Mother, but it held no power over him.\nSpeaking as if she were there with him, he told her stories of everything that happened.
column6: 达梅克最终克服了所有支配着他的恐惧。\n他去过失去母亲的那个地方，但那里再也无法左右他。\n他像对着在场的她说话一样，把发生的一切都讲给她听。

column5: And he was able to leave without feeling sad. Instead, he was happy.\nHe knew that if she were really there — she would be proud of him.\nThat was enough to keep him going when times got tough.
column6: 他离开时不再感到悲伤。相反，他感到幸福。\n他知道，如果她真的在那里——她会为他骄傲。\n在艰难时刻，这就足够支撑他走下去。

column5: Because of your sacrifice, the surviving forces were in a state of disarray.\nHowever, this was put to rest when Ulric stood up and assumed the role of King.\nDamek immediately pledged loyalty to his childhood friend, and served his new King.
column6: 由于你的牺牲，残存的队伍陷入混乱。\n然而，当乌尔里克挺身而出担起国王之位时，一切便平息了。\n达梅克立刻向他儿时的朋友宣誓效忠，为新国王效力。

column5: But he never forgot about you, and what you did in order to secure victory.\nHe used you as a guide on what to do, and was known as kind, and honorable.\nThat was his way of honoring your growing love. Using your ideals as inspiration.
column6: 但他从未忘记你，以及你为夺取胜利所做的一切。\n他以你为行事准则，以仁慈、正直著称。\n那是他纪念你们日渐深厚之爱的方式。以你的理念为指引。

column5: Because of your sacrifice, the surviving forces were in a state of disarray.\nHowever, this was put to rest when Ulric stood up and assumed the role of King.\nDamek immediately pledged loyalty to his childhood friend, and served his new King.
column6: 由于你的牺牲，残存的队伍陷入混乱。\n然而，当乌尔里克挺身而出担起国王之位时，一切便平息了。\n达梅克立刻向他儿时的朋友宣誓效忠，为新国王效力。

column5: But he never forgot about you, and what you did in order to secure victory.\nHe used you as a guide on what to do, and was known as kind, and honorable.\nThat was his way of honoring your friendship. Using your ideals as inspiration.
column6: 但他从未忘记你，以及你为夺取胜利所做的一切。\n他以你为行事准则，以仁慈、正直著称。\n那是他纪念你们友谊的方式。以你的理念为指引。

column5: He remained in his role as Advisor, just under Ulric's leadership instead.\nHonoring your appointment, he served in this capacity until the end of his days.\nHis bond with Ulric stayed as strong as ever, and they always saw eye-to-eye.
column6: 他继续担任顾问一职，只是改为在乌尔里克的领导之下。\n为不负你的任命，他以此身份效力直到生命的尽头。\n他与乌尔里克的情谊始终如故，两人总是心意相通。

column5: As you didn't appoint Damek as your advisor, Ulric made him a General instead.\nHe was in charge of recruiting and training an army — just like Salus was before him.\nHis efficiency in doing so, and his masterful strategizing ensured that Ulric's reign was secure.
column6: 由于你没有任命达梅克为顾问，乌尔里克转而让他当上了将军。\n他负责招募并训练军队——就像他之前的萨卢斯那样。\n他做事高效，谋略出众，确保了乌尔里克的统治稳固。

column5: Damek eventually got over all of the fears that controlled him.\nHe paid visits to the spot where he lost his Mother, but it held no power over him.\nSpeaking as if she were there with him, he told her stories of everything that happened.
column6: 达梅克最终克服了所有支配着他的恐惧。\n他去过失去母亲的那个地方，但那里再也无法左右他。\n他像对着在场的她说话一样，把发生的一切都讲给她听。

column5: And he was able to leave without feeling sad. Instead, he was happy.\nHe knew that if she were really there — she would be proud of him.\nThat was enough to keep him going when times got tough.
column6: 他离开时不再感到悲伤。相反，他感到幸福。\n他知道，如果她真的在那里——她会为他骄傲。\n在艰难时刻，这就足够支撑他走下去。

column5: Thanks to your efforts, Damek was able to live a long, happy life.\nHe served the throne for the rest of his life, remaining forever loyal.\nThe tale of how far he'd come would go down in history, and become legend.
column6: 多亏你的努力，达梅克得以度过漫长而幸福的一生。\n他余生都为王座效力，始终忠诚不渝。\n他一路走来的故事将载入史册，成为传说。

column5: Sovy's past crimes were pardoned after his exceptional performance in Balteus.\nHis defection from The Triumvirate, and his advice regarding them were seen as invaluable.\nWere it not for his actions, and his change of heart — the war would've been lost.
column6: 索维在巴尔泰乌斯的卓越表现，使他的旧罪得到赦免。\n他脱离三人执政团，以及关于他们的建言，被视为无价之宝。\n若非他的行动与幡然醒悟——这场战争早已失败。

column5: True to his word, he used his eternal life to serve The Monarchy.\nHe was able to tell stories of your battles, and keep your legacy alive.\nEvery ruler in the future would know exactly who gave them their power.
column6: 他信守承诺，用自己永恒的生命为王室效力。\n他得以讲述你们战斗的故事，让你的遗志延续。\n未来每一位统治者都会清楚知道，是谁赋予了他们权力。

column5: You never forgot what he did, and your love grew ever stronger.\nThough you started out on shaky ground — things only got better.\nUsing his immortality, he protected your legacy indefinitely.
column6: 你从未忘记他所做的一切，你们的爱愈发深厚。\n尽管你们起初关系不稳——但一切都只会越来越好。\n他借自己的永生，永远守护着你的遗志。

column5: You never forgot what he did, and your bond grew ever stronger.\nThe man who started out as your enemy became your closest ally.\nAn immortal guardian for everybody who would follow your rule.
column6: 你从未忘记他所做的一切，你们的情谊愈发深厚。\n那个起初是你敌人的人，成了你最亲密的盟友。\n一位不朽的守护者，守护着所有追随你统治的人。

column5: Sovy's past crimes were pardoned posthumously, and he was labeled as a hero.\nHis defection from The Triumvirate, and his advice regarding them were seen as invaluable.\nWere it not for his actions, and his change of heart, the war would've been lost.
column6: 索维的旧罪在他身后得到赦免，他被冠以英雄之名。\n他脱离三人执政团，以及关于他们的建言，被视为无价之宝。\n若非他的行动与幡然醒悟，这场战争早已失败。

column5: A memorial service was held, and almost every surviving member of The Rebellion attended.\nEven Ulric showed up. He was happy, knowing that his friend had finally redeemed himself.\nHis story would go down in history, teaching people that nobody is beyond a second chance.
column6: 一场追悼会举行了，几乎所有尚存的反抗军成员都到场了。\n连乌尔里克也来了。得知朋友终于赎清了自己，他感到欣慰。\n他的故事将载入史册，告诉世人没有人不配得到第二次机会。

column5: You never forgot what he did for you and your cause.\nHad he not perished, you're certain that your love would've grown into something special.\nBut you'd never know for sure — and this was always something stuck in the back of your mind.
column6: 你从未忘记他为你和你的事业所做的一切。\n若他没有殒命，你确信你们的爱会成长为某种特别的东西。\n可你永远无法确知——这始终是你心头挥之不去的一个念头。

column5: You saw to it that his mentions in the history books didn't paint him as a villain.\nHe was more of a misguided young man, who eventually came to his senses.\nA victim — molded and twisted to suit his former Master's heinous needs.
column6: 你设法确保史书对他的记载不会把他描绘成恶人。\n他更像是一个误入歧途的年轻人，最终幡然醒悟。\n一个受害者——被前主人骇人的需求所塑造、扭曲。

column5: You never forgot what he did for you and your cause.\nHad he not perished, you're certain you would've become close friends.\nBut you'd never know for sure — and that was always a thought in the back of your mind.
column6: 你从未忘记他为你和你的事业所做的一切。\n若他没有殒命，你确信你们本会成为挚友。\n可你永远无法确知——这始终是你心头挥之不去的一个念头。

column5: Howl survived the war, despite several grievous wounds.\nHis body mended them with ease, and his life continued as normal.\nHe dedicated his life to assisting the throne, and recording history.
column6: 豪尔身负数处重伤，却活过了那场战争。\n他的身体轻易便愈合了伤口，生活照常继续。\n他毕生致力于辅佐王座，并记录历史。

column5: But not current history. He wrote about The Old Monarchy, and their ways.\nIt was almost as if the spirits inside of him felt regret at their actions.\nNobody knew why Howl had this change of heart — but it was for the better.
column6: 但不是当代的历史。他书写旧王室，以及他们的行事之道。\n仿佛他体内的灵对自己的所作所为感到了悔恨。\n没人知道豪尔为何会有这样的转变——但这是好事。

column5: Howl was easily able to balance his writing duties with those of being your advisor.\nBecause of all the spirits inside of him, he was known as a man of great wisdom.\nAnd that wisdom, over time, helped guide Alestia into an age of prosperity.
column6: 豪尔轻松地在写作职责与顾问职责之间取得平衡。\n由于体内寄宿着众多灵，他被视为极富智慧之人。\n而这份智慧，随着时间推移，引领阿莱斯蒂亚步入了繁荣的时代。

column5: As he wasn't appointed as your advisor, he had plenty of time to complete that task.\nHis writings would be placed in The Grand Library, and go on to be read by almost everybody.\nIt helped solidify that The Rebellion was correct. The Triumvirate did {i}not{/i} deserve to rule Alestia.
column6: 由于他未被任命为你的顾问，他有充裕的时间完成那项工作。\n他的著作被收藏进大图书馆，后来几乎人人都会读到。\n它帮助巩固了反抗军是正确的这一认知。三人执政团{i}不{/i}配统治阿莱斯蒂亚。

column5: With your sacrifice, Howl ended up being Ulric's advisor instead.\nThe two seemed to see eye-to-eye on most issues, and ruled with harmony.\nHowl ensured that he wrote about you as well. You were just as important to him.
column6: 由于你的牺牲，豪尔最终转而成了乌尔里克的顾问。\n两人在多数问题上似乎心意相通，执政和睦。\n豪尔也确保写下关于你的文字。你对他同样重要。

column5: However, he chose to write about you and your sacrifice as well.\nIn his eyes, you were an extension of his kind as well — and very important.\nHe called you the bridge between worlds, and attributed victory almost entirely to you.
column6: 然而，他也选择书写你与你的牺牲。\n在他眼中，你也是他族类的延伸——而且至关重要。\n他称你为世界之间的桥梁，并把胜利几乎完全归功于你。

column5: Thanks to your efforts, Howl was able to live a happy life.\nHe was rarely seen outside of the castle, and mostly stuck to writing.\nBut to him, it was worth it in order to teach the world more about his kind.
column6: 多亏你的努力，豪尔得以过上幸福的生活。\n他很少在城堡外露面，大多时间都埋头写作。\n但对他而言，只要能让世界更多了解他的族类，这一切都值得。

column5: Giving Howl his independence came at the cost of his life.\nHowever, he knew the chances of dying were high when he asked.\nPeople would say that you made the right choice by granting him his wish.
column6: 给予豪尔自由，代价是他的生命。\n然而，他提出请求时就知道生还的机会渺茫。\n人们会说，你成全他的心愿是正确的选择。

column5: But since you appointed him as your advisor, there was now a gap to fill.\nFor a while, your work was stressful and incredibly overwhelming.\nIt was thanks to the help of your friends that you prevailed.
column6: 但由于你任命他为顾问，如今空出了一个位置需要填补。\n有一段时间，你的工作压力巨大，令人不堪重负。\n多亏朋友们的帮助，你才挺了过来。

column5: The loss of Howl meant the loss of one of your key allies.\nFor a while, your work was stressful and incredibly overwhelming.\nIt was thanks to the help of your friends that you prevailed.
column6: 失去豪尔，意味着失去了一位关键的盟友。\n有一段时间，你的工作压力巨大，令人不堪重负。\n多亏朋友们的帮助，你才挺了过来。

column5: Many mourned the loss of Howl in the battle for Alestia.\nHis wealth of knowledge about The Monarchy would've filled books.\nHowever, his kind is now all but extinct — a casualty of this ruthless war.
column6: 许多人为豪尔在阿莱斯蒂亚之战中的牺牲而哀悼。\n他关于王室的渊博知识本足以写满许多书。\n然而，他的族类如今几乎灭绝——这场残酷战争的牺牲品。

column5: True to his word, Sovy was never seen again after the trip back to Mazeo.\nSeemingly lost to history, nobody was able to confirm what had happened to him.\nHowever, for almost an eternity — sightings of a man resembling him had been reported.
column6: 他信守承诺，在返回马泽奥的旅途之后，索维再未现身。\n他似乎湮没于历史之中，无人能证实他究竟遭遇了什么。\n然而，在近乎永恒的时间里——不断有人报告见到一名与他相似的男子。

column5: This man had always fought enemies of The Monarchy, ensuring your legacy continued.\nIf it truly {i}was{/i} Sovy, then perhaps his claims of defecting from The Triumvirate were true.\nBut as nobody could prove his true identity, this was simply a matter of conjecture and debate.
column6: 这名男子始终与王室的敌人作战，确保你的遗志得以延续。\n如果他{i}真的{/i}是索维，那或许他脱离三人执政团的说法就是真的。\n但由于无人能证实他的真实身份，这终究只是猜测与争论。

column5: Damek fell during the battle in Balteus, and it was a tragic loss.\nA massive blow to morale made your victory seem somewhat hollow.\nAfter all, were it not for Damek, things would've never gotten this far.
column6: 达梅克在巴尔泰乌斯之战中阵亡，这是惨痛的损失。\n士气的重创让你的胜利显得有些空洞。\n毕竟，若不是达梅克，一切根本走不到这一步。

column5: He was remembered posthumously for his strategical genius.\nIt was incredible how he led The Rebellion after Salus' passing.\nA memorial service was held, and almost every soldier showed up.
column6: 他身后因战略天赋而被铭记。\n萨卢斯离世后，他领导反抗军的方式令人惊叹。\n一场追悼会举行了，几乎每位士兵都到场了。

column5: You were crushed at the loss of Damek. Your closest ally, and lover.\nThough your time together was short, you never got over the loss of your relationship.\nIt was beautiful though, how even in a time of war, love could prevail as much as it did.
column6: 达梅克的牺牲让你痛彻心扉。你最亲密的盟友，也是你的爱人。\n尽管你们相处的时间短暂，你始终未能走出这段感情带来的失落。\n但也美得动人——即便在战争年代，爱仍能如此顽强地绽放。

column5: You were crushed at the loss of Damek, one of your closest allies.\nThough your time together was short, you formed an intense bond.\nEven during a time of war, friendships were able to form and blossom.
column6: 达梅克的牺牲让你痛彻心扉。你最亲密的盟友之一。\n尽管你们相处的时间短暂，却结下了深厚的情谊。\n即便在战争年代，友谊也能萌发、绽放。

column5: Everybody was shocked at losing both you and Damek during the war.\nTwo of the key players were no longer alive to enjoy their hard-fought victory.\nUlric took over as the King in your absence, but never forgot his closest friends.
column6: 战争中同时失去你和达梅克，让所有人震惊。\n两位关键人物已无法活着享受苦战得来的胜利。\n乌尔里克在你缺席时接任国王，但从未忘记他最亲密的朋友们。

column5: The love that you formed with Damek during the war would go down in history.\nA testament to how bonds can flourish even in the darkest of times. A true legend.\nIt was a shame, many thought, that neither of your survived to grow that love even further.
column6: 你在战争中与达梅克结下的爱，将载入史册。\n它见证了羁绊如何在最黑暗的时刻依然绽放。一段真正的传奇。\n许多人认为，可惜你们两人都没能活下来，让这份爱更进一步。

column5: Everybody was shocked at losing both you and Damek during the war.\nTwo of the key players were no longer alive to enjoy their hard-fought victory.\nUlric took over as the King in your absence, but never forgot his closest friends.
column6: 战争中同时失去你和达梅克，让所有人震惊。\n两位关键人物已无法活着享受苦战得来的胜利。\n乌尔里克在你缺席时接任国王，但从未忘记他最亲密的朋友们。

column5: The friendship you formed with Damek during the war would go down in history.\nA testament to how bonds can flourish even in the darkest of times. A true legend.\nIt was a shame, many thought, that neither of your survived to grow that bond even further.
column6: 你在战争中与达梅克结下的友谊，将载入史册。\n它见证了羁绊如何在最黑暗的时刻依然绽放。一段真正的传奇。\n许多人认为，可惜你们两人都没能活下来，让这份情谊更进一步。

column5: Though Damek was lost to the war, his actions were never forgotten.\nHis job of leading The Rebellion after Salus' passing became a legend.\nWere it not for his coordination, things never would've happened as they did.
column6: 尽管达梅克在战争中牺牲，他的事迹从未被遗忘。\n萨卢斯离世后他领导反抗军的作为，成了一段传奇。\n若不是他的协调调度，一切绝不会如此发展。

column5: After his death, all claims that he was responsible for the attack in Mazeo were dropped.\nHe was respected after his passing, and left behind a legacy of trained men and women.\nBecause of what he taught them, The Monarchy would have unparalleled military might.
column6: 他死后，所有称他应对马泽奥袭击负责的指控都被撤销。\n他身后备受敬重，留下了训练有素的男女战士这份遗产。\n正因他的教导，王室拥有了无可匹敌的军力。

column5: Airen personally oversaw the transition of his home from a tavern to a barracks.\nHe wanted to ensure that during the switch, things still met his standards and regulations.\nPeregrino became a source of immeasurable military might, and Airen oversaw all of it.
column6: 艾琳亲自监督自己的酒馆转为兵营的改造。\n他想确保在改建过程中，一切仍符合他的标准与规矩。\n佩雷格里诺成了一股不可估量的军事力量之源，而这一切都由艾琳监管。

column5: Though conflict was rare, Peregrino remained as the first line of defense to protect Valinorth.\nAiren realized that he hadn't lost his home at all. For home was where he and his friends resided.\nHe lived the rest of his days in this new barracks — a proud servant of The New Monarchy.
column6: 尽管冲突罕见，佩雷格里诺依然是保卫瓦利诺斯的第一道防线。\n艾琳意识到自己根本没有失去家。因为家就在他和朋友们所在之处。\n他在这座新兵营里度过了余生——新王室骄傲的一员。

column5: Airen's tavern went on to boom in popularity, being near the birthplace of The Monarch.\nHe was forever thankful that he didn't have to give up his home like Damek had wanted.\nAs a tribute to you, he would rename the tavern in the future. His way of saying thanks.
column6: 艾琳的酒馆因靠近君主的出生地而日渐兴隆。\n他永远感激自己不必像达梅克当初希望的那样放弃自己的家。\n为了向你致敬，日后他将酒馆改了名。那是他表达谢意的方式。

column5: This is where Mylus settled down, unable to decide between Mazeo and Valinorth.\nHe lived a happy and peaceful life, choosing how his remaining days played out.\nBeing free to choose what happened to him — he was never bound by duty again.
column6: 迈勒斯就在这里定居下来，他无法在马泽奥和瓦利诺斯之间做出选择。\n他过着幸福安宁的生活，自己决定余下的日子如何度过。\n能够自由选择自己的命运——他再也不被职责所束缚。

column5: After the chaos dwindled, Alex returned to Mazeo, and started a new life.\nHis treaty was honored, and pirates were forgiven for all they had done.\nAll bans were lifted, and pirates were officially employed as traders.
column6: 混乱平息后，亚历克斯回到马泽奥，开始了新的生活。\n他的条约得到了履行，海盗们的所作所为得到了宽恕。\n所有禁令解除，海盗被正式聘为商人。

column5: Though Alex perished in Balteus, his treaty was posthumously honored.\nAll trade bans were lifted, and pirates were officially employed by the nation.\nThe Mazean Shipping Company, along with Mazeo, entered a new age of prosperity.
column6: 尽管亚历克斯在巴尔泰乌斯牺牲，他的条约仍在他身后得到履行。\n所有贸易禁令解除，海盗被国家正式聘用。\n马泽奥航运公司与马泽奥一同步入了繁荣的新时代。

column5: All criminal records were lifted, and every pirate was free to enter society as an equal.\nImprisoned pirates were released, as well — uniting families that had been torn apart.\nThis would go down in history as one of the biggest, and greatest changes to Alestia.
column6: 所有犯罪记录被撤销，每个海盗都能以平等身份自由融入社会。\n被监押的海盗也获释了——让支离破碎的家庭得以团聚。\n这将成为阿莱斯蒂亚历史上最大、最伟大的变革之一。

column5: Nada was never seen again. It was assumed that she didn't agree with these changes.\nOr perhaps she was spiteful that you didn't choose to align with her demands.\nEither way, Alestia would forever remember her as a ruthless pirate lord.
column6: 娜达再未现身。人们推测她不认同这些变革。\n又或许，她因你没有选择迎合她的要求而心怀怨恨。\n无论如何，阿莱斯蒂亚会永远记住她这个冷酷无情的大海盗。

column5: After finding himself fully redeemed, Gryz returned to his office as Mayor.\nHonoring the pirate treaty he had coordinated, he helped Mazeo adjust to every change.\nHe had long since been forgiven by the people — but it was only now that he forgave himself.
column6: 在彻底赎清自己之后，格瑞兹重返市长之位。\n他履行自己促成的那份海盗条约，帮助马泽奥适应每一项变革。\n人民早已宽恕了他——但直到此刻，他才宽恕了自己。

column5: Gryz was a casualty of this ruthless war, but his legacy lived on.\nStepping up as Mayor of Mazeo, Lillith continued what he started.\nShe honored the pirate treaty, and helped Mazeo adjust to every change.
column6: 格瑞兹是这场残酷战争的牺牲品，但他的遗志延续了下来。\n莉莉丝接任马泽奥市长，继续他未竟的事业。\n她履行那份海盗条约，帮助马泽奥适应每一项变革。

column5: The Monarch Vessels were affected by your attack on the dark idol.\nAs if offering their strength when needed the most, the excess spirits vanished.\nWhen the fog of war settled, they were left as individuals — free of pain and despair.
column6: 君主容器们受到了你对黑暗灵像那记攻击的影响。\n仿佛在最需要的时候献出了自己的力量，多余的灵消散了。\n当战火平息，他们作为独立的个体留存下来——摆脱了痛苦与绝望。

column5: A small ceremony was held to mourn and honor the sacrifice of your Monarch Vessels.\nThough their life on Alestia was short — they had completed enough to be known as heroes.\nBut many wondered what would've happened if they survived. Could a cure to their pain be found?
column6: 人们举行了一场小小的仪式，哀悼并致敬君主容器们的牺牲。\n尽管他们在阿莱斯蒂亚的生命短暂——他们所做的一切已足以被称为英雄。\n但许多人不禁想，若他们活下来会怎样。能否找到治愈他们痛苦的办法？

column5: Vivien returned to Alarinthia and led it into a new age.\nNo longer was the fate of the nation in the hands of the strong.\nAlarinthia existed in unity with The New Monarchy, and it flourished.
column6: 薇薇安回到了阿拉林西亚，引领它步入新的时代。\n这个国家的命运不再掌握在强者手中。\n阿拉林西亚与新王室同心共存，繁荣昌盛。

column5: Trade routes were introduced, and its ports were open to everybody.\nThe strict security and immigration process had been abolished permanently.\nHolding a ball every year, Vivien kept up the tradition of giving to the people.
column6: 贸易路线开通了，港口向所有人敞开。\n严苛的安保与入境审查被永久废除。\n薇薇安每年举办一场舞会，延续着回馈民众的传统。

column5: One thing was for sure — Alarinthia would never be in the hands of the strong again.\nVivien lived out a long and happy life in the nation he had always dreamed of creating.
column6: 有一点可以肯定——阿拉林西亚再也不会落入强者之手。\n薇薇安在他一直梦想缔造的国度里，度过了漫长而幸福的一生。

column5: Because Vivien had perished, Ulric stood up as his Champion.\nHe helped ensure that Alarinthia remained on the path of the victorious party.\nSoon enough, it changed its ways, and existed in unity with The New Monarchy.
column6: 由于薇薇安牺牲，乌尔里克以他的斗士身份挺身而出。\n他帮助确保阿拉林西亚始终站在胜利一方。\n很快，它便改弦更张，与新王室同心共存。

column5: Trade routes were introduced, and its ports were open to everybody.\nA representative of The Monarchy was elected to lead the nation into a new age.\nHolding a ball every year, Alarinthia kept up its tradition of giving back to the people.
column6: 贸易路线开通了，港口向所有人敞开。\n一位王室的代表被推选出来，引领这个国家步入新的时代。\n阿拉林西亚每年举办一场舞会，延续着回馈民众的传统。

column5: One thing was for sure — Alarinthia would never be in the hands of the strong again.\nThough Vivien wasn't alive to enjoy this new nation, his story would live on for an eternity.
column6: 有一点可以肯定——阿拉林西亚再也不会落入强者之手。\n尽管薇薇安未能活着看到这个新国家，他的故事将永远流传。

column5: Draycu returned to Alarinthia and continued to rule it with his iron grip.\nChallengers came and went, but Draycu was always victorious in the coliseum.\nHe was known as the first ruler of Alarinthia who succumbed to old age, and natural causes.
column6: 德雷库回到阿拉林西亚，继续以铁腕统治。\n挑战者来来去去，德雷库却始终在竞技场中胜出。\n他被称为阿拉林西亚第一位因年迈与自然原因而离世的统治者。

column5: After his passing, a grand tournament was held, and anybody was capable of entering.\nBecause nobody challenged Draycu, the nation would have to start with a clean slate.\nA new ruler emerged, and Alarinthia stayed largely the same for the rest of history.
column6: 他去世后，一场盛大的锦标赛举行了，任何人都可以参加。\n因为无人挑战德雷库，这个国家只能从零开始。\n一位新的统治者产生了，此后的历史中，阿拉林西亚大体保持原样。

column5: With the loss of Draycu, Alarinthia had experienced something entirely new.\nThis was the first time that a ruler had not fallen to a challenger in the coliseum.\nA new, grand tournament was held in order to find the strongest in the nation.
column6: 失去德雷库，让阿拉林西亚经历了全然新鲜的事。\n这是第一次有统治者没有在竞技场中败给挑战者。\n一场新的盛大锦标赛举行了，以找出全国最强之人。
